findings.title: Security Hub not enabled in module
findings.description: AWS Security Hub should be enabled for centralized security findings aggregation and CIS benchmark checks. Add an aws_securityhub_account resource. Only evaluated on modules with 5+ resources to avoid noise on trivial configurations.

findings.title: Amazon Detective not enabled in module
findings.description: Amazon Detective should be enabled for ML-driven security investigation across CloudTrail, VPC flow logs, and GuardDuty findings. Add an aws_detective_graph resource. Only evaluated on modules with 5+ resources to avoid noise on trivial configurations.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: CloudTrail trail is not an organization trail
findings.description: A trail that is not an organization trail records API activity for a single account only. An organization trail centralizes audit logging across every account in the organization.
findings.remediation: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

findings.title: CloudTrail trail without CloudTrail Insights
findings.description: CloudTrail Insights detects unusual API activity and errors automatically. A trail with no insight_selector block never benefits from anomaly detection on management events.
findings.remediation: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.
